_comment: Gates of the replay lane (CLIPS.md 15.13, tools/stream-gate/src/replay.rs, scripts/replay-gate.sh), per lane and clip, in the schema of benchmarks/baselines/stream/gates.json. The structural gates (length, start frame, frame order, game audio offset; the loopback row's offset) are absolute: they come from the plan, never from a run, and a test in replay.rs keeps them equal to replay::structural_gates and replay::loopback_gates. The quality floors (psnr_y_mean, ssim_y_mean, vmaf_mean) come from `scripts/replay-gate.sh --lane <lane> --repeat 3 --write-baseline` on one commit and machine: the first run's value minus the largest of a fixed margin (VMAF 2 points, PSNR 1 dB, SSIM 0.01) and 1.1 x the spread of the runs, the rule of tools/stream-gate/make_gates.py; baseline-<lane>.json keeps the runs and _spread the values. A lane without floors has the structural gates only. The playback row (--playback, tools/stream-gate/src/playback.rs) has absolute gates only: the time to the first frame, no buffering state after it, the frame order, the seek to 20 s; a test in replay.rs keeps them equal to playback::gates. Gates may tighten; they never loosen.
